abstraction: ncclMeshPageCoverage declaration (ncclMeshBuffer active, expected)
handles: Naming the coverage mask and count words a masked transfer publishes and its consumer reads.
replacement: composition: coverage words are cut-ordinal -> virtual page entries of the function's page map, specialized at final lowering

abstraction: ncclMeshBuffer word, indices
handles: Naming the publication word and the selected-cut index rows a contributing source writes.
replacement: composition: word and index rows are virtual pages of the page map; their bytes are emitted only at final lowering

abstraction: isl relation dispatch group -> physical region byte
handles: Exact first-reader/last-writer solving over aliased storage, keyed on region byte positions.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: accesses map groups to virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page); hazards are found in page coordinates

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> buffer, slot, invocation, byte layout
handles: Declaring a source's per-group byte accesses over a Metal buffer so the solve can see them.
replacement: composition: the access layout composes with a page-table operand, not a Metal buffer; the buffer is bound at final lowering

abstraction: ncclMeshBuffer selected, destination; cellBytes
handles: Naming the selector rows and destination storage of a data-dependent writer.
replacement: composition: selector and destination are page-map operands; cell byte size stays in the layout, offsets appear only at final lowering

abstraction: ncclMeshBuffer activity
handles: Naming the UInt32 entry predicate a conditional source reads.
replacement: composition: the predicate is a page of the map, bound at final lowering

abstraction: ncclMeshPageEffect (ncclMeshBuffer word, violation), id<MTLBuffer> payload, payload-local byte layout, selection to physical byte
handles: Carrying one transfer's publication word, payload buffer and selected bytes into the effect solve.
replacement: composition: payload and word are page-map operands; selection is logical byte -> virtual page; physical bytes only at final lowering

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> buffer + buffer-local byte offsets -> region byte offsets
handles: Canonicalizing every declared byte use into one physical coordinate so aliases meet.
replacement: image of the page map: the page table already names physical pages; no conversion from a buffer's bytes

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> buffer parameter
handles: Importing a serialized source access and placing it on physical bytes.
replacement: composition of the imported relation with a page-table operand

abstraction: (id<MTLBuffer> buffer, NSUInteger offset)
handles: Attaching a conditional source's predicate word.
replacement: composition: the predicate is a page-map operand

abstraction: host pointer in ncclMeshBuffer.offset -> ncclMeshMemBuffer (MTLBuffer, offset)
handles: Normalizing a host-path operand into a Metal binding before solving.
replacement: inverse eliminated: operands arrive as page-table entries; the Metal binding is made at final lowering

abstraction: buffer.contents + offset -> ncclMeshRegionRuns region offsets
handles: Giving coverage operands an identity that equal storage shares across distinct buffer views.
replacement: image of the page map: identity is the page-table id with its physical page indices

abstraction: ncclMeshBuffer active/expected, retained MTLBuffer, equality by region runs
handles: Deduplicating coverage declarations that name the same mask and count words.
replacement: image of the page map: equality of page identities

abstraction: PageBuffer(word), PageBuffer(indices), retained MTLBuffer
handles: Holding the contribution's word and index rows for the solve.
replacement: composition: page-map operands, bound at final lowering

abstraction: buffer.contents + first -> ncclMeshRegionRuns; isl b -> b - at + run.offset (region byte)
handles: Translating a buffer-local byte relation into region bytes so the solve sees aliasing across views.
replacement: composition with the page map (virtual page -> physical page) read from the page table; no contents pointer and no region offsets

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> + byte layout -> region relation
handles: Placing an ordered selected-byte layout on physical bytes.
replacement: composition of the layout with the page map

abstraction: buffer.contents + first -> region runs; region byte -> buffer byte
handles: Mapping physical bytes back to logical bytes of a selection.
replacement: inverse of the page map (the page table's run list) composed with the layout's inverse

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> buffer -> MetalPageRegionRelation
handles: Importing a serialized source access onto physical bytes.
replacement: composition with a page-table operand

abstraction: retained id<MTLBuffer>; MetalPageRegionRelation(buffer)
handles: Resolving a declared access layout to physical bytes.
replacement: composition with the page map

violation: chooser picks a map by hand
abstraction: [bytes shift:displacement] byte displacement per invocation

replacement: lifetime allocation: invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page) supplies the slot; no byte shift

abstraction: PageBuffer(selected), PageBuffer(destination), retained MTLBuffer
handles: Holding a selector writer's selected rows and destination storage.
replacement: composition: page-map operands, bound at final lowering

abstraction: (buffer, offset) and the byte relation offset <= b < offset+4 -> region

replacement: composition: predicate is a page-map operand; its access is group -> virtual page

abstraction: ncclMeshMemBuffer((void *)e.word.offset), (void *)e.violation.offset; retained payload MTLBuffer

replacement: inverse eliminated: words are page-map operands from the declaration

abstraction: buffer.contents + word.offset -> ncclMeshRegionRuns run.offset

replacement: image of the page map: a word is a physical page index plus an in-page word ordinal

abstraction: word.offset + 4*c byte relation -> MetalPageRegionRelation(word.buffer)
handles: Mapping each coverage cut ordinal to the word that defines it.
replacement: composition: cut ordinal -> virtual word page of the page map

abstraction: indices.offset + width*8*(g-first) byte relation; MetalPageRegionRelation(indices.buffer)
handles: Adding the reads of contribution index rows and coverage words to a command's accesses.
replacement: composition of the index-row layout with the page map

abstraction: ncclMeshBuffer active/expected passed to PageCoverageWords

replacement: composition: coverage cuts -> virtual word pages

abstraction: isl sets of region bytes (access->relation ranges, remaining words)

replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: PageWord region offset as dictionary key; domains sorted by region offset
handles: Grouping publications that share one word into one ordered domain.
replacement: image of the page map: group by the word's page identity; order by declared ordinal, not physical address

abstraction: region-byte sets: selection ranges minus later arrivals and later writes
handles: Ending an arrival's observations once a later arrival or a command overwrites the same bytes.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: PageCoverageWords(ncclMeshBuffer active) region bytes
handles: Naming the mask word a masked observation depends on.
replacement: composition: coverage cut -> virtual word page

abstraction: region-byte relations of mask pages subtracted from known reads
handles: Closing predicate reads so mask pages that arrive under other masks are ordered too.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: PageWord(effect.word) region offset as the key of observers, domains, consumed and terminal
handles: Matching observations, contributions and terminal results that use the same publication word.
replacement: image of the page map: the word's page identity from the page table

abstraction: region-byte sets: remaining selected bytes, writer relations, arrival coverage
handles: Finding each publication cut's contributing writers and the arrivals that supply its unproduced inputs.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: [NSValue valueWithPointer:] of declaration commands, transfers and initials as dictionary keys
handles: Binding a second occurrence's commands and transfers to the retained declaration's.

abstraction: MetalLeaseBuffer + memcpy into buffer.contents

replacement: lifetime allocation of metadata pages in the function's page map; the effector writes their literal contents at final lowering

violation: chooser picks a map by hand
abstraction: four fresh lease buffers per domain (thresholds, completed, expected, arrivals), cached on the domain
handles: Giving each publication domain its own prefix state pages.

abstraction: (id<MTLBuffer>, offset, bytes) fields and MetalReach {buffer, offset, bytes} records
handles: Collecting every word and table a command's effects read or write into one metadata view.
replacement: composition of page selections in the page map; residency follows from the map's image

abstraction: key string "%p %lu %lu" of the buffer's host address
handles: Deduplicating fields that name the same buffer bytes.
replacement: image of the page map: dedupe by (page-table id, page index)

abstraction: ncclMeshPageTableCreate({buffer,0}); first=offset/width; composed offset cursor*width+offset%width
handles: Turning (buffer, offset) fields back into page selections and their offsets in one composed view.

abstraction: buffer.contents of an offset table written with composed byte offsets
handles: Writing a runtime table that maps a cut to its word's byte offset in the metadata view.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: emit the word's base + affine offset; no offset table

abstraction: PageWord region offset compared to select contributions
handles: Selecting the contributions that publish into this domain's word.
replacement: image of the page map: compare page identities

abstraction: fields added by (buffer, offset); ncclMeshBuffer {pages[2],0}; projection entries [field, at*4] byte offsets

replacement: composition: cut -> virtual word page of the page map

abstraction: emitted (mesh_effects+((ulong*)ordinals)[cut]) offset-table lookup
handles: Finding a dynamic cut's expected-count word at run time.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table
note: cut is data-dependent; the residual is a gather whose static cut -> word map should be composed into the producer's index or emitted as base + affine.

abstraction: emitted per-group cut table read ((long*)indices)[mesh_effect_group-first] from a PageData lease

replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table
note: The table is static at preparation; the affine case at 996-1013 already emits literals.

abstraction: emitted per-group (cut, flags) announcement table read at (mesh_effect_group*width+column)*2
handles: Giving each dispatch group the coverage cuts it announces.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table
note: Static at preparation; specialization as in the affine contribution path.

abstraction: fields add:(indices.buffer) offset:indices.offset
handles: Binding a contribution's runtime index rows into the metadata view.
replacement: composition: index rows are pages of the map

abstraction: region-byte intersection of mask range and selection ranges
handles: Ordering source-local predicate observations so a mask is available before it is evaluated.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: region-byte intersection of the activity read and arrival selections
handles: Finding the observations an entry predicate needs before it runs.
replacement: preimage of the intersection of images: the solve runs on virtual pages composed with invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page), never on region bytes

abstraction: byWord keyed by PageWord region offset; PageData record of polls/channel/entry/thresholds in a lease

handles: Giving each dispatch group its wait threshold when thresholds differ by group.

note: Thresholds are known at preparation; a per-group table is a map evaluated at run time.

abstraction: PageWordField/PageViolationField (buffer, offset); violation span buffer.length-word.offset
handles: Binding an observation's word and its diagnostic area into the metadata view.
replacement: composition: word and diagnostic pages of the map; their extent is the map's image
